items.title: Return signed Form W-8BEN
items.quote:
Please sign the enclosed form and return it to Member Services no later than
September 13, 2027.
items.computation: The letter states an explicit calendar date by which the signed Form W-8BEN must be received by Member Services: September 13, 2027. This is a fixed deadline set by a foreign (US) private institution, not a German authority, so German delivery-fiction rules (e.g. §§ 187, 188, 193 BGB or administrative-law delivery presumptions) do not apply; the date is taken as given. September 13, 2027 falls on a Monday, so no weekend/holiday adjustment is needed.

warnings: This is a US (non-German) financial institution requesting a signed tax form by mail; before signing and returning any personal/tax form, verify independently (e.g. via the phone number or website on your existing account statements, not just the one printed in this letter) that this request is genuine and not a phishing attempt, since IRS-form requests are a known scam vector.
